status: C03 anatomical feasibility screen; not C04 circuit selection
pair_aggregation: sum syn_count over all neuropil rows for each ordered pre_root_id -> post_root_id pair
side_reporting: count all biological left/right/center inputs and additionally count fully same-side chains; do not discard mixed-side paths in C03
feasible_for_screen: at least one fully same-side photoreceptor reaches each member of a left/right output-role pair at the stated threshold
candidate_flags: retain outlier_seg for anatomical feasibility and report it; inclusion is a separate C04 decision
